name: Minute Pudding No. 1
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: piece of butter as large as half an egg
ingredients.originalText: a piece of butter as large as half an egg

instructions.text: Set saucepan or deep frying pan on the stove, the bottom and sides well buttered
Put into it a quart of sweet milk, a pinch of salt and a piece of butter as large as half an egg
When it boils, stir in sifted flour, sifting it through your fingers, a handful at a time, until it becomes smooth and quite thick
Turn it into a dish that has been dipped in water
Make a sauce very sweet to serve with it
Add canned berries or fresh ones just before taking from the stove if desired

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Set saucepan or deep frying pan on the stove, the bottom and sides well buttered
2. Put into it a quart of sweet milk, a pinch of salt and a piece of butter as large as half an egg
3. When it boils, stir in sifted flour, sifting it through your fingers, a handful at a time, until it becomes smooth and quite thick
4. Turn it into a dish that has been dipped in water
5. Make a sauce very sweet to serve with it
6. Add canned berries or fresh ones just before taking from the stove if desired
